description: LIBRARY FIRST. Browse Picorn's own libraries (photos, wallpapers, vector illustrations, ~300k icons, stickers, textures, shapes, badges) and SEE the hits as one numbered contact sheet. Free, also without an account. This is the same search the Blueprint engine runs: once a hit fits, write `search q1 <kind> "<words>"` with the same kind and words in picorn_blueprint_compile and the compile gets these pictures in this order (wallpaper → background, vector → illustration). Words may be German or English; short concrete English nouns match best. Generating a picture costs credits and is the exception: only when nothing here fits and the design would benefit massively.
name: picorn_search_library
title: Picorn: browse the picture library
